021/**
022 * Represents a rectangular analysis region (“square”) in a PAINT recording.
023 * <p>
024 * Each square stores its geometric origin, statistics derived from associated
025 * tracks, and flags describing visibility and exclusion status.
026 */
027public class Square {
028
029    private String  uniqueKey;
030
031    /*=========================================================================
032     *  CORE ATTRIBUTES
033     *=========================================================================
034     */
035    private String  experimentName;
036    private String  recordingName;
037    private int     squareNumber;
038    private int     rowNumber;
039    private int     colNumber;
040    private int     labelNumber;
041    private int     cellId;
042    private boolean visible;
043    private boolean squareManuallyExcluded;
044    private boolean imageExcluded;
045
046    /* Spatial coordinates: top-left (x0,y0), bottom-right (x1,y1) */
047    private double  x0;
048    private double  y0;
049    private double  x1;
050    private double  y1;
051
052    /* Track-derived metrics */
053    private int     numberOfTracks;
054    private double  variability;
055    private double  density;
056    private double  densityRatio;
057    private double  densityRatioOri;
058    private double  tau;
059    private double  rSquared;
060    private double  medianDiffusionCoefficient;
061    private double  medianDiffusionCoefficientExt;
062    private double  medianDisplacement;
063    private double  maxDisplacement;
064    private double  totalDisplacement;
065    private double  medianMaxSpeed;
066    private double  maxMaxSpeed;
067    private double  medianMedianSpeed;
068    private double  maxMedianSpeed;
069    private double  maxTrackDuration;
070    private double  totalTrackDuration;
071    private double  medianTrackDuration;
072
073    /* Associated objects */
074    private List<Track> tracks      = new ArrayList<>();
075    private Table       tracksTable = null;
076

078     * Creates an empty {@code Square}.
079     */

081    }

087    /**
088     * Creates a fully-specified {@code Square} with geometric coordinates.
089     *
090     * @param uniqueKey      a unique identifier for this square (typically exp§rec§num)
091     * @param experimentName name of the experiment containing this square
092     * @param recordingName  name of the recording containing this square
093     * @param squareNumber   index of this square in the recording (0..N-1)
094     * @param rowNumber      row index in the grid
095     * @param colNumber      column index in the grid
096     * @param x0             top-left x coordinate in µm
097     * @param y0             top-left y coordinate in µm
098     * @param x1             bottom-right x coordinate in µm
099     * @param y1             bottom-right y coordinate in µm
100     */
101    public Square(String uniqueKey,
102            String experimentName,
103            String recordingName,
104            int squareNumber,
105            int rowNumber,
106            int colNumber,
107            double x0, double y0,
108            double x1, double y1) {
109
110        initialiseDoublesToNaN(this);
111        this.uniqueKey      = uniqueKey;
112        this.experimentName = experimentName;
113        this.recordingName  = recordingName;
114        this.squareNumber   = squareNumber;
115        this.rowNumber      = rowNumber;
116        this.colNumber      = colNumber;
117        this.x0             = round(x0, 2);
118        this.y0             = round(y0, 2);
119        this.x1             = round(x1, 2);
120        this.y1             = round(y1, 2);
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * Computes the theoretical square area for a given grid size.
125     *
126     * @param n total number of squares in the recording grid
127     * @return the area of a single square in µm²
128     */
129    public static double calculateSquareArea(int n) {
130        return IMAGE_WIDTH * IMAGE_HEIGHT / n;
131    }

646    /**
647     * Resets all calculated metrics to {@link Double#NaN}.
648     * This is useful before re-running calculations or when a square fails
649     * to meet the minimum requirements for analysis.
650     */
651    public void resetCalculatedAttributes() {
652        this.tau                           = Double.NaN;
653        this.rSquared                      = Double.NaN;
654        this.variability                   = Double.NaN;
655        this.density                       = Double.NaN;
656        this.densityRatio                  = Double.NaN;
657        this.densityRatioOri               = Double.NaN;
658        this.medianDiffusionCoefficient    = Double.NaN;
659        this.medianDiffusionCoefficientExt = Double.NaN;
660        this.medianDisplacement            = Double.NaN;
661        this.maxDisplacement               = Double.NaN;
662        this.totalDisplacement             = Double.NaN;
663        this.medianMaxSpeed                = Double.NaN;
664        this.maxMaxSpeed                   = Double.NaN;
665        this.medianMedianSpeed             = Double.NaN;
666        this.maxMedianSpeed                = Double.NaN;
667        this.maxTrackDuration              = Double.NaN;
668        this.totalTrackDuration            = Double.NaN;
669        this.medianTrackDuration           = Double.NaN;
670    }
671
672    @Override
673    public String toString() {
674        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
675
676        sb.append("\n----------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
677          .append("Square ").append(squareNumber)
678          .append(" (Experiment: ").append(experimentName != null ? experimentName : "N/A").append(")\n")
679          .append(" (Recording: ").append(recordingName != null ? recordingName : "N/A").append(")\n")
680          .append("----------------------------------------------------------------------\n");
681
682        sb.append(String.format("Row,Col Number                 : %d,%d%n", rowNumber, colNumber));
683        sb.append(String.format("Coordinates [x0,y0]-[x1,y1]    : [%.2f, %.2f] - [%.2f, %.2f]%n", x0, y0, x1, y1));
684        sb.append(String.format("Unique Key                     : %s%n", uniqueKey != null ? uniqueKey : "N/A"));
685        sb.append(String.format("Label Number                   : %d%n", labelNumber));
686        sb.append(String.format("Cell ID                        : %d%n", cellId));
687
688        sb.append(String.format("Visible                        : %b%n", visible));
689        sb.append(String.format("Square Manually Excluded       : %b%n", squareManuallyExcluded));
690        sb.append(String.format("Image Excluded                 : %b%n", imageExcluded));
691
692        sb.append(String.format("Number of Tracks               : %d%n", numberOfTracks));
693        sb.append(String.format("Variability                    : %.4f%n", variability));
694        sb.append(String.format("Density                        : %.4f%n", density));
695        sb.append(String.format("Density Ratio                  : %.4f%n", densityRatio));
696        sb.append(String.format("Tau                            : %.4f%n", tau));
697        sb.append(String.format("R²                             : %.4f%n", rSquared));
698
699        sb.append(String.format("Median Diffusion Coefficient   : %.4f%n", medianDiffusionCoefficient));
700        sb.append(String.format("Median Diffusion CoefficientExt: %.4f%n", medianDiffusionCoefficientExt));
701        sb.append(String.format("Median Displacement            : %.4f%n", medianDisplacement));
702        sb.append(String.format("Max Displacement               : %.4f%n", maxDisplacement));
703        sb.append(String.format("Total Displacement             : %.4f%n", totalDisplacement));
704
705        sb.append(String.format("Median Max Speed               : %.4f%n", medianMaxSpeed));
706        sb.append(String.format("Max Max Speed                  : %.4f%n", maxMaxSpeed));
707        sb.append(String.format("Median Median Speed            : %.4f%n", medianMedianSpeed));
708        sb.append(String.format("Max Median Speed               : %.4f%n", maxMedianSpeed));
709
710        sb.append(String.format("Max Track Duration             : %.4f%n", maxTrackDuration));
711        sb.append(String.format("Total Track Duration           : %.4f%n", totalTrackDuration));
712        sb.append(String.format("Median Track Duration          : %.4f%n", medianTrackDuration));
713
714        if (tracks != null) {
715            sb.append(String.format("Tracks attached                : %d%n", tracks.size()));
716        }
717        if (tracksTable != null) {
718            sb.append("Tracks table available\n");
719        }
720
721        return sb.toString();
722    }

728    public enum Column {
729
730        UNIQUE_KEY(                       "Unique Key",                       ColumnType.STRING),
731        EXPERIMENT_NAME(                  "Experiment Name",                  ColumnType.STRING),
732        RECORDING_NAME(                   "Recording Name",                   ColumnType.STRING),
733        SQUARE_NUMBER(                    "Square Number",                    ColumnType.INTEGER),
734        ROW_NUMBER(                       "Row Number",                       ColumnType.INTEGER),
735        COLUMN_NUMBER(                    "Column Number",                    ColumnType.INTEGER),
736        LABEL_NUMBER(                     "Label Number",                     ColumnType.INTEGER),
737        CELL_ID(                          "Cell Id",                          ColumnType.INTEGER),
738        VISIBLE(                          "Visible",                          ColumnType.BOOLEAN),
739        SQUARE_MANUALLY_EXCLUDED(         "Square Manually Excluded",         ColumnType.BOOLEAN),
740        IMAGE_EXCLUDED(                   "Image Excluded",                   ColumnType.BOOLEAN),
741        X0(                               "X0",                               ColumnType.DOUBLE),
742        Y0(                               "Y0",                               ColumnType.DOUBLE),
743        X1(                               "X1",                               ColumnType.DOUBLE),
744        Y1(                               "Y1",                               ColumnType.DOUBLE),
745        NUMBER_OF_TRACKS(                 "Number of Tracks",                 ColumnType.INTEGER),
746        VARIABILITY(                      "Variability",                      ColumnType.DOUBLE),
747        DENSITY(                          "Density",                          ColumnType.DOUBLE),
748        DENSITY_RATIO(                    "Density Ratio",                    ColumnType.DOUBLE),
749        DENSITY_RATIO_ORI(                "Density Ratio Ori",                ColumnType.DOUBLE),
750        TAU(                              "Tau",                              ColumnType.DOUBLE),
751        R_SQUARED(                        "R Squared",                        ColumnType.DOUBLE),
752        MEDIAN_DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT(     "Median Diffusion Coefficient",     ColumnType.DOUBLE),
753        MEDIAN_DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT_EXT( "Median Diffusion Coefficient Ext", ColumnType.DOUBLE),
754        MEDIAN_DISPLACEMENT(              "Median Displacement",              ColumnType.DOUBLE),
755        MAX_DISPLACEMENT(                 "Max Displacement",                 ColumnType.DOUBLE),
756        TOTAL_DISPLACEMENT(               "Total Displacement",               ColumnType.DOUBLE),
757        MEDIAN_MAX_SPEED(                 "Median Max Speed",                 ColumnType.DOUBLE),
758        MAX_MAX_SPEED(                    "Max Max Speed",                    ColumnType.DOUBLE),
759        MEDIAN_MEDIAN_SPEED(              "Median Median Speed",              ColumnType.DOUBLE),
760        MAX_MEDIAN_SPEED(                 "Max Median Speed",                 ColumnType.DOUBLE),
761        MAX_TRACK_DURATION(               "Max Track Duration",               ColumnType.DOUBLE),
762        TOTAL_TRACK_DURATION(              "Total Track Duration",            ColumnType.DOUBLE),
763        MEDIAN_TRACK_DURATION(             "Median Track Duration",           ColumnType.DOUBLE);
764
765        public final String     header;
766        public final ColumnType type;
767
768        Column(String header, ColumnType type) {
769            this.header = header;
770            this.type = type;
771        }
772    }
